paired_comparison: Same prompt, seed, scheduler, size, steps and guidance; only adapter changes. Record adapter scale and full artifact hashes.
statistical_unit: Report prompt-level means across seeds. Bootstrap prompt clusters with paired base/LoRA differences; do not claim 64 independent prompts.
metrics: independent CLIP image-text cosine similarity (proxy, not factual ground truth)
nearest-training-image similarity screening, not proof of absence of memorization

visual_review.reviewer: AI-assisted visual audit; not human ground-truth annotation

validation_boundary: Training validation images, loss and separate development prompts select checkpoint; this frozen prompt grid and official held-out images do not.
reporting_rule: Retain all outputs and failures. Report regressions as well as gains. No assumed fine-tuning improvement and no paired SSIM target for open-ended text-to-image generation.
